definitions.full: H8134. Shinab שִׁנְאָב proper name, masculine king of Admah Genesis 14, Σεννααρ (see שִׁנְעָר 1Chr 8:1 , ᵐ5 id. ). שִׁנְאָן see below III. שׁנה .
